evidence.quote: Ben Armitage Investment Analyst Ben Armitage is an Investment Analyst on the Evenlode Global Income strategies team and joined Evenlode in 2021. He was previously a VC Investment Analyst, predominantly assessing UK-based early-stage science and tech start-ups spinning out of academia. Ben graduated from Huddersfield University with an MChem and from Oxford University with a PhD in Materials Science. He has also gained the Investment Management Certificate.
